credential_suggestions.label: FiberHome ONT — prefilled defaults
credential_suggestions.provenance: Login field names and these two default values are retained from the pre-universal dashboard at commit 3bd1d55. They are editable convenience defaults, not stored secrets.
notes: The browser pre-fills these values; nothing authenticates until Connect is pressed.
The connector profile references this key only to select its credential suggestion; no values are copied into profiles.

credential_suggestions.label: Gateway — prefilled defaults
credential_suggestions.provenance: Legacy pre-fill values retained from the pre-universal dashboard at commit 3bd1d55 for editable convenience.
notes: Used only for gateways without a matched connector profile.
The user can correct the gateway address and credentials before pressing Connect.
